d: Namaa Partners has started an operating performance project with a corporate group in Saudi Arabia and is hiring a Business Data Analyst in the Kingdom for it and for the engagements that follow. You will turn client data on sales, costs, staffing and operations into clean tables, dashboards and short findings that our consultants take to management. The job is full-time and remote, from home anywhere in Saudi Arabia. The rest of the team works from Oklahoma City, eight to nine hours behind Riyadh, so expect some calls at the end of your working day.
Collect extracts from clients' finance, HR and operations systems and check them for gaps and errors
Clean, join and reshape the data in Excel, SQL or Python so business units and years can be compared
Build Power BI dashboards that show the performance measures agreed for each engagement
Write short notes that explain what changed in the numbers and why
Record every source, assumption and adjustment so the work can be checked
q: A bachelor's in statistics, mathematics, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field
Excel, including pivot tables and XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH
Basic SQL: SELECT queries with joins and aggregations
At least one dashboard you built, at university, in an internship or at work
Tableau, or the Microsoft PL-300 Power BI certificate
Medical insurance for you and your family
Twenty-five days of paid annual leave, plus Saudi public holidays
End-of-service award under the Saudi Labor Law
A yearly budget for courses and professional certificates
Laptop and home office equipment, provided by Namaa
Namaa Partners is a management consulting firm based in Oklahoma City. We advise corporate groups, family enterprises and their boards on strategy, governance and operating performance.
